newsitem.title: UK: Euro straight-run fuel oil markets steady, inactive.
newsitem.headline: Euro straight-run fuel oil markets steady, inactive.

text.p: European straight-run markets were quiet on Friday, with sellers under no pressure to close deals and eager to hold on to better price levels reached this week, traders said.
Offers were around the $100 fob mark, with some dealers believing that an optimistic level, given that U.S. demand has moderated a little. Bids were heard to be around the $95 level.
"Most straight-run cargoes are so far out that bids and offers just aren't coming together at the moment," said one trader.

No Russian feedstock cargoes were seen traded on Friday but supply was looking good in the first half of May. Euro refiners were reported to have a healthier interest in the material than in previous weeks.
